Typography and Text Styling

Typography is the art of arranging type to make text readable and visually appealing

font-family, font-size, line-height, letter-spacing, and text-align

Colors and Visual Design

color, background-color, border-color, It also supports CSS variables for defining and reusing color palettes across an application, as well as media queries for adapting to light/dark themes

Spacing and Alignment

margin, padding, border-spacing, and gap

Visual Hierarchy and Proportions

CSS also plays a role in defining visual hierarchy using font sizes (font-size), weights (font-weight), colors (color), and positioning (position, z-index). Developers can use CSS Grid or Flexbox to create hierarchical structures within the layout

Animations and Transitions

transition and @keyframes It supports smooth changes between states (e.g., hover effects, fade-ins, sliding effects) and is often used to enhance interaction design.

Responsive Design

CSS supports responsive design through the use of media queries, which allow different styles to be applied depending on the screen size, orientation, or resolution

Accessibility

CSS also includes tools to help with accessibility, like controlling contrast using color and background-color, ensuring text resizing with rem and em units, and supporting high-contrast themes.
